description: Exact containment of a declared track against convective cell boundaries, including NON-CONVEX footprints: decide whether the track stays outside every declared cell within that cell's altitude layer, and on a breach name the breaching segment, the cell, how the breach happens and the exact parameter along the segment where it does. Exact integer crossing number over micro-degree vertices, with the optional standoff decided by comparing squared distances — no square root, no floating point, no epsilon. Advisory only; not a dispatch or flight-planning authority.

cells.description: declared convective cells: id, vertices, and layer as decimal strings. Declaring none returns NOT_MEASURED_NO_CONVECTIVE_CELLS_DECLARED, never CONTAINED. e.g. [{"id":"SQUARE","base_feet":"0","top_feet":"40000","vertices":[{"lat_micro_deg":"0","lon_micro_deg":"0"},{"lat_micro_deg":"0","lon_micro_deg":"30000"},{"lat_micro_deg":"30000","lon_micro_deg":"30000"},{"lat_micro_deg":"30000","lon_micro_deg":"0"}]}]

base_feet.description: decimal string, cell base altitude in feet, e.g. 0

top_feet.description: decimal string, cell top altitude in feet, e.g. 40000

vertices.description: three or more polygon vertices in micro-degrees, e.g. [{"lat_micro_deg":"0","lon_micro_deg":"0"},{"lat_micro_deg":"0","lon_micro_deg":"30000"},{"lat_micro_deg":"30000","lon_micro_deg":"30000"},{"lat_micro_deg":"30000","lon_micro_deg":"0"}]

lat_micro_deg.description: decimal string, vertex latitude in micro-degrees, e.g. 30000

lon_micro_deg.description: decimal string, vertex longitude in micro-degrees, e.g. 30000

margin_micro_deg.description: optional standoff as decimal string in the same declared units; strict, so exactly this far away is contained. e.g. 1000

track_micro_deg.description: lat_micro_deg,lon_micro_deg,alt_feet points as decimal strings; two or more, since this names a breaching SEGMENT. e.g. [{"lat_micro_deg":"50000","lon_micro_deg":"50000","alt_feet":"30000"},{"lat_micro_deg":"50000","lon_micro_deg":"80000","alt_feet":"30000"}]

alt_feet.description: decimal string, altitude in feet, e.g. 30000

lat_micro_deg.description: decimal string, latitude in micro-degrees, e.g. 50000

lon_micro_deg.description: decimal string, longitude in micro-degrees, e.g. 50000

name: weather.convective_containment
